"""Hosted native-operation route contract tests with a real local backtest."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from src.api.mona_operations import _market_data_request, _OperationStore, register_mona_operations
from src.api.request_ledger import register_native_request_ledger
from src.api.security import require_auth


def _write_local_backtest(home: Path) -> None:
    run_dir = home / "runs" / "route-contract"
    (run_dir / "code").mkdir(parents=True)
    (run_dir / "config.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "codes": ["local:600000.SH"],
                "start_date": "2025-06-02",
                "end_date": "2025-06-09",
                "source": "local",
                "engine": "daily",
                "interval": "1D",
                "initial_cash": 10000,
                "position_adjustment": "hold",
                "slippage": 0,
            }
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (run_dir / "code" / "signal_engine.py").write_text(
        "import pandas as pd\n"
        "class SignalEngine:\n"
        "    def generate(self, data_map):\n"
        "        result = {}\n"
        "        for symbol, bars in data_map.items():\n"
        "            weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=bars.index)\n"
        "            if len(weights) > 3:\n"
        "                weights.iloc[1:3] = 0.5\n"
        "            result[symbol] = weights\n"
        "        return result\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    bytecode_cache = run_dir / "code" / "__pycache__"
    bytecode_cache.mkdir()
    (bytecode_cache / "signal_engine.cpython-313.pyc").write_bytes(b"must not be copied")
    (run_dir / "code" / "old-bytecode.pyc").write_bytes(b"must not be copied")
    local_cache = run_dir / "code" / "cache"
    local_cache.mkdir()
    (local_cache / "old-cache.bin").write_bytes(b"must not be copied")
    bars_path = home / "bars.csv"
    bars_path.write_text(
        "date,open,high,low,close,volume\n"
        "2025-06-02,10,10.2,9.9,10,10000\n"
        "2025-06-03,10,10.4,9.9,10.2,12000\n"
        "2025-06-04,10.2,10.8,10.1,10.7,11000\n"
        "2025-06-05,10.7,10.8,10.5,10.6,9000\n"
        "2025-06-06,10.6,11,10.5,10.9,10000\n"
        "2025-06-09,10.9,11.2,10.8,11.1,10000\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    bridge = home / "data-bridge"
    bridge.mkdir(parents=True)
    (bridge / "config.yaml").write_text(
        "sources:\n"
        "  - symbol: 600000.SH\n"
        "    type: csv\n"
        f"    path: {json.dumps(str(bars_path))}\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    stale_output = run_dir / "artifacts"
    stale_output.mkdir()
    (stale_output / "old-result.csv").write_text("must not be copied\n", encoding="utf-8")
    cache = run_dir / "cache"
    cache.mkdir()
    (cache / "old-cache.bin").write_bytes(b"must not be copied")


def _input_hash(run_dir: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        path.relative_to(run_dir).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for path in sorted((run_dir / "config.json", *(run_dir / "code").rglob("*")))
        if path.is_file()
    }


def _wait_operation(client: TestClient, operation_id: str, headers: dict[str, str]) -> dict:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 120
    detail = client.get(f"/mona/operations/{operation_id}", headers=headers)
    while detail.status_code == 200 and detail.json()["status"] in {"queued", "running"}:
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            raise AssertionError("native backtest operation did not reach a terminal state")
        time.sleep(0.1)
        detail = client.get(f"/mona/operations/{operation_id}", headers=headers)
    assert detail.status_code == 200, detail.text
    return detail.json()


def test_market_data_rejects_unserved_interval_and_unknown_fields() -> None:
    from fastapi import HTTPException

    try:
        _market_data_request(
            {
                "symbol": "600519.SH",
                "start_date": "2026-09-01",
                "end_date": "2026-09-30",
                "interval": "4H",
            }
        )
    except HTTPException as exc:
        assert exc.status_code == 422
        assert "Eastmoney" in exc.detail
    else:  # pragma: no cover - assertion message is clearer than a response mismatch
        raise AssertionError("unsupported A-share interval was accepted")

    try:
        _market_data_request(
            {
                "symbol": "600519.SH",
                "start_date": "2026-09-01",
                "end_date": "2026-09-30",
                "interval": "1D",
                "path": "C:/secret.csv",
            }
        )
    except HTTPException as exc:
        assert exc.status_code == 422
    else:  # pragma: no cover
        raise AssertionError("unknown physical-path field was accepted")


def test_real_backtest_runs_through_idempotent_production_route(tmp_path, monkeypatch, request) -> None:
    home = tmp_path / "private-vibe-home"
    home.mkdir()
    _write_local_backtest(home)
    monkeypatch.setenv("VIBE_TRADING_HOSTED", "1")
    monkeypatch.setenv("VIBE_TRADING_HOME", str(home))
    monkeypatch.setenv("VIBE_TRADING_ALLOWED_RUN_ROOTS", str(home / "runs"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("API_AUTH_KEY", "local-test-key")
    monkeypatch.setenv("MONA_VIBE_INSTANCE_ID", "test-instance-0009")
    monkeypatch.setenv("PYTHON_DOTENV_DISABLED", "1")
    from src.config.accessor import reset_env_config

    reset_env_config()
    request.addfinalizer(reset_env_config)

    app = FastAPI()
    register_native_request_ledger(app, require_auth)
    register_mona_operations(app)
    client = TestClient(app, client=("127.0.0.1", 50000))
    headers = {
        "Authorization": "Bearer local-test-key",
        "X-Mona-Request-ID": "00000000000000000000000000000009",
    }
    payload = {"operation": "backtest", "run_id": "route-contract"}
    input_run = home / "runs" / "route-contract"
    input_before = _input_hash(input_run)

    first = client.post("/mona/operations", headers=headers, json=payload)
    assert first.status_code == 202, first.text
    operation_id = first.json()["operation_id"]
    replay = client.post("/mona/operations", headers=headers, json=payload)
    assert replay.status_code == 202
    assert replay.json()["operation_id"] == operation_id
    record = _wait_operation(client, operation_id, headers)
    assert record["status"] == "completed", record
    result = json.loads(record["tool_result_raw"])
    assert result["status"] == "ok", result
    assert result["exit_code"] == 0, result
    output_run_id = record["references"]["run_id"]
    assert record["references"]["input_run_id"] == "route-contract"
    assert output_run_id != "route-contract"
    assert record["payload"]["input_run_id"] == "route-contract"
    output_run = home / "runs" / output_run_id
    assert Path(result["run_dir"]).resolve() == output_run.resolve()
    assert not (output_run / "artifacts" / "old-result.csv").exists()
    assert not (output_run / "cache").exists()
    assert not (output_run / "code" / "cache").exists()
    assert not (output_run / "code" / "old-bytecode.pyc").exists()
    assert _input_hash(input_run) == input_before
    assert record["source"]["instance_id"] == "test-instance-0009"
    assert record["source"]["snapshot_id"].startswith("sha256:")
    assert (output_run / "run_card.json").is_file()
    assert (output_run / "artifacts" / "metrics.csv").is_file()
    assert client.get("/mona/operations", headers=headers).json()["active"] == 0

    ledger = client.get(
        "/mona/requests/00000000000000000000000000000009", headers=headers
    ).json()
    assert ledger["status"] == "completed"
    assert ledger["receipt"]["body"]["operation_id"] == operation_id

    second_request_id = "0000000000000000000000000000000b"
    second_headers = {**headers, "X-Mona-Request-ID": second_request_id}
    second = client.post("/mona/operations", headers=second_headers, json=payload)
    assert second.status_code == 202, second.text
    second_id = second.json()["operation_id"]
    second_record = client.get(f"/mona/operations/{second_id}", headers=headers).json()
    second_output_id = second_record["references"]["run_id"]
    assert second_output_id not in {"route-contract", output_run_id}
    second_record = _wait_operation(client, second_id, headers)
    assert second_record["status"] == "completed", second_record
    assert _input_hash(input_run) == input_before
    assert (home / "runs" / second_output_id / "artifacts" / "metrics.csv").is_file()


def test_restart_marks_queued_jobs_interrupted_without_replaying(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> None:
    home = tmp_path / "private-vibe-home"
    monkeypatch.setenv("VIBE_TRADING_HOME", str(home))
    store = _OperationStore()
    store.create(
        "0" * 32,
        "backtest",
        {"operation": "backtest", "run_id": "stale"},
        {"run_id": "stale"},
        {"instance_id": "test", "data_root_sha256": "x", "source": {"patches": []}},
    )
    store.recover_once()
    assert store.get("0" * 32)["status"] == "interrupted"
    assert store.active_count() == 0
